data_source_document: Implementing Order 4-63, ordered 2025-06-26, effective 2025-06-30. Supersedes IO-04-63 of 2024-10-01.

residential_construction_new_sfr_duplex.applies_to: Detached single family and duplex new construction
residential_construction_new_sfr_duplex.notes: Multi-unit townhomes use $0.40/sqft. Master Model/Cookie Cutter pricing differs.

residential_construction_addition_sfr_du.applies_to: Additions to single family residence or duplex

residential_alterations_repairs.applies_to: Alterations or repairs to SFR or duplex
residential_alterations_repairs.notes: $0.070 per $1.00 of estimated cost. Hard maximum at $847.95.

commercial_alterations_tiered.applies_to: Alterations and repairs to buildings (except SFR and duplex). Total fee = sum of each separate tier fee.

roofing_replace_shingles.applies_to: Roofing shingle and other roof types (per sqft of roof coverage including overhangs)

roofing_replace_tile.applies_to: Roofing tile (per sqft of roof coverage including overhangs)

roofing_hardening_tile.applies_to: Tile roof under Residential Hardening permit type (existing SFR/duplex/townhome only)
roofing_hardening_tile.notes: Applies only under Residential Hardening Improvement and Repair Type Permit, not new construction.

roofing_hardening_other.applies_to: All other roof types under Residential Hardening permit type

hvac_install_per_ton.applies_to: Air conditioning and refrigeration including relocation of equipment, per ton capacity (or fractional part). Separate permits required for electrical, water, gas connections.

hvac_exact_change_out_hardening.applies_to: Exact change out of central AC unit including heating, under Residential Hardening permit type
hvac_exact_change_out_hardening.notes: Hardening permit type — applies only to existing SFR/duplex/townhome dwellings. Not new construction or additions.

mechanical_residential_new_per_sqft.applies_to: Mechanical SFR/duplex new construction per sqft (includes categories 03, 10, 41)

furnace_heating_per_kw.applies_to: Furnaces, heating equipment, commercial dryers, ovens, fired objects

electrical_service_install.applies_to: Permanent service to buildings, new work only. Charged on total amperage of service.

electrical_panel_exact_change_out_harden.applies_to: Exact change out of existing electrical panel, under Residential Hardening permit type

electrical_residential_wiring_new.applies_to: New construction SFR, duplex, living units of Group H/R-1. Applies to all electrical installations except common areas and house service of Group H/R.

electrical_residential_alterations.applies_to: Alterations or repairs (electrical) per $1.00 of estimated cost

plumbing_residential_new_per_sqft.applies_to: New SFR or duplex plumbing per sqft

plumbing_residential_alterations.applies_to: Alterations or repairs (plumbing) per $1.00 of estimated cost

plumbing_water_heater_replace_hardening.applies_to: Exact change out of water heater greater than 50 gallons, Residential Hardening permit type
plumbing_water_heater_replace_hardening.notes: For water heaters under 50 gallons or other configurations, falls under standard alterations rate (6% of estimated cost).

plumbing_solar_water_heater.applies_to: Solar water heater installation, equipment replacement, or repair

window_door_residential_replace.applies_to: Window, glass block, exterior doors, storefronts, fixed glass, curtain wall installation/retrofit/repair for SFR (not exact change out of existing)
window_door_residential_replace.notes: Minimum residential permit fee. HVHZ rules require NOA-approved products for exterior.

window_door_hardening_exact_change.applies_to: Exact change out of existing windows and doors under Residential Hardening permit type

swimming_pool_install_residential.applies_to: Installation of residential swimming pool or spa

swimming_pool_repair_residential.applies_to: Repair of residential swimming pool or spa

generator_install_under_20kw_hardening.applies_to: Installation or exact change out of residential generator under 20KW, Residential Hardening permit type

solar_pv_system.applies_to: Solar photovoltaic per system. Custom roof flashing details require additional roofing review.

solar_pv_hardening_standardized.applies_to: Solar PV per system using Miami-Dade County's standardized roof flashing, under Residential Hardening permit type

operational_fees.notes: Minimum permit fee $147 applies to residential and all other uses. Additional inspection fee charged beyond initial and one follow-up. Double fee (100% additional) penalty when work commenced without permit.

surcharges_and_fees.notes: Miami-Dade RER surcharge of 7.5% applies on all Building Permitting fees except Enforcement (IO-04-63 Section I.A.15). State statutory DBPR/BCAIF 1.5% per FS 468.631 and DCA 1.5% per FS 553.721 apply on top. Code Administration fee assessed at $0.60 per $1,000 of work value (IO-04-63 Section V.E).

processing_time.notes: Expedited plan review available for an additional fee, billed hourly. Concurrent electronic plan processing supported via department portal.

sources: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, Florida (Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach MSA)
RSMeans City Cost Index for Miami metro
labor_cost_premium.notes: HVHZ counties command higher labor premium than non-HVHZ Florida counties. Hurricane season demand and NOA-required specialized installer requirements both contribute. Per IO-04-63, project value calculations use RSMeans Manual when applicant's estimate is lower.

incorporated_city_notes._scope_note: Miami-Dade has 34 incorporated municipalities. The 4 below are the largest with their own building departments. Many other Miami-Dade cities maintain separate schedules but are not listed in this v1.1.

Miami.notes: City of Miami building department sets its own fees per Section 10-18 of City of Miami Ordinance.

Coral Gables.notes: Coral Gables maintains stringent historic preservation review for many projects, which can extend timelines and add fees.

Miami Beach.notes: Coastal construction control line restrictions apply for many projects.

hvhz_notice_of_acceptance.applies_to: Exterior wind-rated products (windows, doors, roofing, shutters)
hvhz_notice_of_acceptance.notes: NOA listing required for products used in HVHZ. Florida Product Approval alone is insufficient.

forty_year_recertification.applies_to: Buildings 40 years old, then every 10 years
forty_year_recertification.notes: Permit application fees per IO-04-63 Section I.I. Additional repair scope ($2-5k typical) is market estimate, not a county fee. Triggers structural and electrical recertification.

fbc_8th_edition.notes: Florida Building Code 8th Edition (2023) is current. Replaces FBC 7th Edition (2020).

coastal_construction_control_line.applies_to: Properties seaward of the CCCL — beachfront and immediately adjacent
coastal_construction_control_line.additional_review: State DEP review required in addition to local permit
coastal_construction_control_line.notes: Coastal construction within CCCL has additional state-level requirements.

residential_hardening_permit_type.applies_to: Existing SFR/duplex/townhome dwellings for repair, replacement, improvement (NOT new construction or additions)
covered_work_types: Exact change out of central AC unit including heating
Exact change out of existing windows and doors
Installation or exact change out of residential generator under 20KW
Exact change out of existing electrical panel
Solar PV per system with standardized roof flashing
Repair or replacement of existing fencing
Exact change out of water heater greater than 50 gallons
residential_hardening_permit_type.notes: Pilot program assessed annually. Flat $130 fee for most work types listed. Provides a streamlined permitting path for common residential improvements.
